newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-PSV BEAT AZ TO SECURE TOP SPOT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PSV BEAT AZ TO SECURE TOP SPOT.

text.p: PSV Eindhoven pulled clear at the top of the Dutch league on Saturday with a 2-1 revenge win over AZ Alkmaar who beat them in the cup last week.
The victory put PSV three points ahead of Feyenoord, their main title rivals. Feyenoord have to beat Ajax away on Sunday to rejoin PSV in first place.
PSV took an 11th minute lead with a solo goal by young winger Boudewijn Zenden.
Just after halftime AZ midfielder Silvan Inia found the net but was ruled offside.
In the 65th minute Wim Jonk stretched the scoreline to 2-0 from the penalty spot after an offence by AZ midfielder Michael Buskermolen.
Seven minutes later Hans Gillhaus replied but AZ never looked capable of salvaging a draw.
The match ended on a sour note when PSV's Yugoslav midfielder Zeljko Petrovic and AZ's Polish striker Krzystof Bociek were sent off 10 minutes from time.
Twente Enschede tightened their grip on third place, two points behind Feyenoord, by beating Graafschap Doetinchem 2-1 away.
Jan van Halst scored their first in the 62nd minute with a penalty and one minute later Joeri Petrov added the second.
Graafschap scored a late consolation goal through Edwin Godee.
